# Living in Northern Nevada | McCarthy Group

> City and neighborhood guides for Northern Nevada from James and Michele McCarthy of McCarthy Group at Dickson Realty (NV brokerage license BS.014763). Pricing, lifestyle and buying guidance for Dayton, Washoe Valley, Incline Village, Spanish Springs, Verdi, Fernley, Yerington and Smith Valley.

Contact: mccarthygroup@mccarthygrouprealty.com | (775) 391-0565 | https://mccarthygrouprealty.com/contact

## City guides

- [All city guides](https://livinginnorthernnevada.com/): Overview of every Northern Nevada community we serve.
- [Dayton](https://livinginnorthernnevada.com/dayton): Dayton Valley, Santa Maria Ranch, New Empire, Sutro Heights, Riverpark.
- [Washoe Valley](https://livinginnorthernnevada.com/washoe-valley): Custom homes and horse properties between Reno and Carson City.
- [Incline Village](https://livinginnorthernnevada.com/incline-village): Lake Tahoe North Shore homes.
- [Spanish Springs](https://livinginnorthernnevada.com/spanish-springs): Master-planned living northeast of Sparks.
- [Verdi](https://livinginnorthernnevada.com/verdi): Truckee River community on Reno's western edge.
- [Fernley](https://livinginnorthernnevada.com/fernley): Affordable, fast-growing Lyon County city along I-80.
- [Yerington](https://livinginnorthernnevada.com/yerington): Lyon County seat and Mason Valley hub.
- [Smith Valley](https://livinginnorthernnevada.com/smith-valley): Rural ranch and acreage properties.
